tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje bdag chen ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil chog gi gsal byed 'phrin las kun khyab ces bya ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ya/ rigs gsum rnam 'phrul sa skya'i rje btsun gyi/ /gsang gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i drin can rje/ /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i bla ma dang / /mchog gsum dbyer med mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo rgyal/ /bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /cho ga'i gsal byed 'phrin las kun khyab 'di/ /tshad ldan gong ma'i gsung bzhin spel ba la/ /chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis skabs phye zhig de la 'dir rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil chog gi gsal byed bri ba la/ rdul tshon la brten pa dang / ras bris la brten pa gnyis las/ dang po bstan pas phyi ma zhar byung du rtogs par 'gyur bas/ de'i dang po rdul tshon la brten pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gang du dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i sar skya thig rdzogs par btab pa kyai rdor bzhin la/ dbus kyi padma 'dab brgyad kyi sar padma 'dab brgyad cung chung ba bris pa'i phyi'i brtsig pa'i nang du 'phar ma gnyis pa'i rnam pa ji ltar rigs pa btab pa ma gtogs gzhan bdag med ma yi nang thig ni/ /rtsa thig nang du lha snam la/ /cha chen gcig pa gru bzhir gdab/ /dbus nas de la reg par bskor/ /'od phreng dang ni rdor phreng la/ /cha bran re re bskor bar bya/ /dbus nas cha chen lte bar bskor/ /de nang ze 'bru pad lte la/ /cha phran re re bskor bar bya/ /lte ba'i phyi ru 'dab brgyad bri/ /'phar ma gnyis pa'i byed tshul 'di/ /rgyud dang gong ma'i dgongs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor 'di la rtsig pa'i nang du lha snam cha chen gru bzhir 'debs/ de'i thig la reg pa de dang lte ba'i bar du dum bu gnyis bgos nas/

cha chen gcig lte ba la bskor/ de'i nang du cha phran re re ba gnyis gnyis bskor ba ni ze 'bru dang pad lte'o/ phyi'i bskor thig gi nang du'ang cha phran re re ba gnyis bskor ba ni 'od zer phreng ba dang rdo rje'i phreng ba yin no/ /'di ni rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo'i dgongs pa yin no/ /yang 'phags pa rin po ches padma nyis brtsegs bya ba yang gsungs kyang 'dir ni rtse mo'i dgongs pa bzhin snga ma de nyid ma chugs par bya'o/ /me ri'i bar 'dra'o/ /de'i dbus su dri'i thig le gru bzhi pa dang / pad 'dab brgyad/ phyi'i 'phar ma'i phyogs mtshams brgyad/ shar sgo nub sgo gnyis te gnas bco brgyad du dri'i thig le zlum po'i steng du dbus su tshom bu re/ byang shar du sa lha'i tshom bu ste nyi shu dgod/ de'i phyi rol gyi byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog shar du zhabs bsil dang zhal bsil gnyis/ tshangs thig gi g.yas g.yon dang shar lhor 'thor 'thung / lhor mchod yon/ lho nub tu me tog nub kyi tshangs thig gi lho phyogs su bdug spos/ byang phyogs su mar me/ nub tu dri chab/ byang du zhal zas/ de rnams sgor mchod bshams pa'i nang du sgos mchod/ spos mar me lha bshos gsum tshan pa bzhi shar du/ nub tu tshan pa gsum/ lho byang gnyis su tshan pa gnyis re/ mtshams bzhir tshan pa re ste bco lnga'o/ /de yang shar gyi bzhi ni gtso mo/ chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ baitta lī/ sa spyod ma/ nub kyi gsum ni rdo rje ma/ gau rī/ mkha' spyod ma/ lho'i gnyis ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ ghasma rī/ byang gi gnyis ni gsang ba'i dkar mo/ tsau rī/ mtshams bzhi ni byang shar du pukka sī/ shar lhor ri khrod ma/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo/ nub byang du gsang ba'i dkar mo rnams kyi'o/ /bum thod bzhi la tshom bu ma gtogs mchod pa dang bskyed chog mi dgos/ zhes pa 'di ni sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung rtsom 'phro can gyi dkyil mchog na yang 'di bzhin gsungs 'dug pas yid gnyis bya mi dgos pa lags shing /

sngon gyi dkyil thang 'ga' zhig la yang padma 'dab bzhi byas te bum thod bzhi gtan nas med pa yang byung ngo / /sa lha'i tshom bu'i mdun du gong bzhin sgos mchod cig dang / zlum gtor cig ras bris ltar na dkyil thang 'grem sar lha mo bco lnga bum thod dang bcas pa'i tshom bu maṇḍal che ba bkod pa man dzi'i steng du maṇḍal chung bar bkod pa'i sa lha'i tshom bu 'og tu bshams pa sogs ma gtogs gzhan phal cher rdul tshon gyi phyogs dang 'dra'o/ /gzhan yi dam chos skyong sogs la mchod gtor dgos pa rang rang gi phyag len bzhin gang 'os su bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma phyag len bzhin dang / slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ nang mchod/ gos zung / bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gnyis legs par bkrus la/ mgul chings kha rgyan sogs dang / rnam rgyal la bum mtshan padma'i steng du gri gug bris pa dang / las bum la sna tshogs rdo rje bris pa gdags/ 'khyil pa'i sngags a mṛ ta sogs bzla zhing / bum pa'i kha nas gu gul gyis bdug 'gab nas yungs kar kyis brab la/ nang chu gtsang gis sum gnyis dgang / 'bru lnga sogs dang / bdud rtsi ril bu re dang bum rdzas sum cu rtsa lnga ci 'byor btab/ khyad par kha che sogs kyis mdog 'gyur ba tsam bya/ rnam rgyal las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon la kha phyogs pa'i g.yas rang gi g.yon phyogs dang / las bum las kyi rdo rje slob dpon la kha phyogs pa'i g.yon du rang gi g.yas phyogs bzhag rnam rgyal steng du dung chos sogs dri bzang gi chus bkang ba dang / de'i steng rdo rje gzungs thag bzhag slob ma sta gon dgos na gnas gsum byin gyis brlob pa'i ting sogs su dri bzang gi chu cung zad blug la/ nyer spyod lnga/ khyor chu dang / so shing / dpung skud/ ku sha gsum slob ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa bshams pa sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len la zhib par bya'o/

/de nas dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod pa'i mdun du sngon 'gro gtor ma chus sbyangs te/ mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma bsang sbyang byin rlabs mdzad de 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang / de nas rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas sngon 'gro gtor ma la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs te/ 'og tu bsang sbyang zhes 'byung ba rnams su'ang 'di dran par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma la lag pa g.yon pa bstan te oṃ/ g.yas bstan te āḥ gnyis ka bstan te hūm̐/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis bkug la/ oṃ mahā bhū ta sa pa ri wa ra a karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas gtor mgron spyan drangs/ pad skor dang bcas pas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ inda dza ma/ dza la/ dzakkha/ bhū ta/ ba hni/ bā u/ rakkha/ tsand+ra/ sudzdza/ mā da/ pappa/ ta la/ pā tā le/ āṣṭa sa pa swāhā/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ bhuñdza/ dzi gha/ phulla/ dhū paṃ/ maṃ sa/ piṃ gha/ aṃ bha/ sappa/ kādzdza/ swā dāe/ khanti/ khu ṇi/ phe ḍa/ gā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ adya nutpanna twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing se gol brdab pa lan gsum gyis phul/ de nas so so'i phyag rgya dang yab kyi bzhin bcas la/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra bar sbyar la/ dhū pe/ a lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta 'di phyag len gsung rgyun la mi mdzad/ zhes pas phyi mchod/ oṃ mahā bhu ta sa pa ri wa ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes dang / g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod phul/ rdo rje dang bcas pas thal mo g.yas pa nu ma g.yas kyi steng du bya/ dril bu snying kha'i thad du gsum brdung bya zhing / dkar mo ri dgas kyis mchod/

mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /padma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ rdo rje thugs kar bzung / dril bu chig brdung bya zhing / lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /zhes sogs nas/ ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces dang / rdo rje thugs khar bzung ba de kha'i ngang nas dril bu rgyun dkrol bya zhing /

dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i go 'phang 'thob par bya ba'i ched du/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te ras bris yin na bzhengs te zhes pa'i tshig 'dor bar bya'o/ /'di bzhin sa lha dang phyi rol gtor ma sogs la'ang rigs 'gre shes par bya/ bsgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blangs ba 'tshal na/ zhes pa tsam mam/ slob ma yod na slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ zhes pa skabs dang sbyar la/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin kyi bar bar du gcod pa zhes pa gsung rgyun/ chad thams cad bsrung ba dang / de nas kyang byang chub ma thob bar kyi bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang stongs grogs mdzod cig muḥzhes brjod/ lag pa g.yas pa sa la reg pas gtor mgron rnams bsgrub khang gi phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams su gshegs par bsam/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang pa'i 'byung po gdug pa can de dag 'dir ma gnas pa gzhan du song zhig ces pa 'di gsung rgyun yin/ 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba de dag sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces dang / de nas yum gyi phreng sngags brjod/ rdo rje gsor/ dril bu drag tu dkrol la/ gtor mgron gyi phyi 'brang gi bgegs rnams ring du bskrad par bsam la gtor ma sa gtsang sar bskyal lo/ /yang mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal la/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la byin rlabs gnang ba zhu/ zhes dang / de nas gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhruṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/

sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams āḥlas byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pa gsung rgyun/ mtha' khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur/ ces dang / so so'i phyag rgya rje btsun yab kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar bcas te/ oṃ nī rī hūm̐ kham̐ swāhā/ oṃ badzra nai wi dye hūm̐ kham̐ swāhā/ oṃ sarba sam̐ sho dha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ kham̐ ram̐ mahā arghaṃ pra titstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' gzhan rnams la'ang sbyar te/ dhu pe/ a lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta'i bar dang / mthar rdo rje snying khar bzung dril bu rgyun dkrol dang / rol mo ji snyed pa 'bud dkrol dang bcas/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba buddha kṣe pra/ pra tsa li te/ pradzñā pā rā mi ta/ nā da swa bhā we/ badzra dharma hri da ya santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis kyang byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /de nas zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad spyi dang 'dra bar byas la/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa bsdus te yig brgya'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin rdzogs par nyams su blangs la dkyil 'khor bsdus te gtso mo la thim pa'i bar brjod la/ gtso mo'i nga rgyal du gnas bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rang gtso mo'i nga rgyal las he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can du gyur/

hi hi zhes brjod pas bgegs rnams bskrad par gyur/ de nas sa lha'i sgos mchod kyi mar me sbar/ sa lha'i tshom bu bsang sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhi ba'i nyams can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis bklubs pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa thugs khar 'dzin pa/ de'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ sogs nas/ thugs khar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang khu tshur gnyis dpung mgor bsnol te se gol gyi sgra byas nas mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu ltar bkug pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ 'og nas rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgya zhes 'byung ba rnams su 'di dran par bya'o/ /oṃ badzra gau rī a karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes sogs bzhis dgug zhugs bcing / de nas dbang lha spyan drangs ba ni/ slar yang thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan zhes brjod cing bsam/ oṃ pri thi wi de wi/ zhes pa so so'i mgor sbyar ba'i/ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs nas shapta'i bar dang / gaṇḍa ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pas phyi mchod/ gtor ma chab kyis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyi mthar/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ces brjod/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin byas la/ oṃ pri thi wi de wi/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ/

zhes sogs lan gsum se gol dang bcas te phul/ rdor dril 'dzin pas tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su phyag len la mi dgos rdo rje gsor dril bu bcad btub dkrol la/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin/ /bdag med ma dpal khros mchod pa/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /shākya seng ge skyobs pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ dril bu rgyun brdung ngos/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / zhes sogs gong sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin las/ 'tshal na zhes pa'i mthar/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces lha mos gsungs shing gnang ba thob par bsam/ lag pa g.yas sa la reg ste/ oṃ badzra muḥ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim par gyur/ ces brjod la sa lha'i tshom bu mchod gtor dman pa rnams bsdu'o/ /lha sta gon ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshom bu bsang sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ zhes pa nas/ me rab tu 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gyur/ oṃ rakṣa zhes sogs kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ de lta bu'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdengs ka gyen du bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ de'i nang du yaṃ las skabs 'dir 'byung ba bzhi'i sa bon dang dbyibs sogs sgrub thabs bzhin brjod na shin tu legs so/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs bzhin gyi 'byung bzhi bskyed chog mdzad pa gsung rgyun/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/

de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du bhrum̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa bhrum̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi bar snang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ dmar po gnyis kyi mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa de rnams 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa la thim ste thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang / zhes pa nas/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing chen po brgyad/ shing gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba brgyad/ shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong ba brgyad/ steng gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i klu chen po brgyad/ gzhan yang chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / 'dre dang / srin po dang / mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / ro dang / ro langs la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang 'phar ma gnyis pa'i nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngon po'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mu khyud la rdo rje'i ra ba dang / 'od zer phreng bas bskor ba'i dbus dang / phyogs bzhir nyi ma dang / ro'i gdan re re/ phyi'i phyogs mtshams brgyad/ gtso mo'i 'og dang / steng rnams su padma dang / nyi ma dang / ro'i gdan re re dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ badzra ne ratma na ma/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rdo rje bdag med ma/ ām̐ badzra badzri na maḥ shar du rdo rje ma/ iṃ badzra gau rī na maḥ lhor gsang ba'i dkar mo/ īṃ badzra wa ri na maḥ nub tu chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ um̐ badzra ḍa ki na maḥ byang du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ ūm̐ badzra pukka sī na maḥ

'phar ma phyi ma'i byang shar du pukka sī/ ṛṃ badzra sha wa ri na maḥ shar lhor ri khrod ma/ ṝṃ badzra tsaṇḍa li na maḥ lho nub tu tsaṇḍa li/ l̥ṃ badzra ḍombhi ni na maḥ nub byang du ḍombhi nī/ līṃ badzra gau rī na maḥ shar du gau rī/ eṃ badzra tsau rī na maḥ lhor tsau rī/ a badzra baitta li na maḥnub tu baitta li/ oṃ badzra ghasma rī na maḥ byang du ghasma ri/ auṃ badzra bhū tsa ri na maḥ 'og tu sa spyod ma/ am̐ badzra ṣe tsa ri na ma/ steng du mkha' spyod ma ste lha mo thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ smin mtshams su khro gnyer bsdus pa/ cung zad 'dzum zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brjes pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje/ gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar te 'dzin pa/ g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs khar bsnams pa/ g.yon pa'i gru mor rdo rje'i kha ṭwaṃ ga la dril bu dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan cing / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon pa'i mthil gyis ro'i steng du mnan zhing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /lha de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon bum bskyed dang mdun bskyed dngos gzhi sogs ye shes pa spyan 'dren 'og ma kun la yang tshig rigs 'di kho na mdzad pa gsung rgyun yin/ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ 'gro ba bud med 'dul gzigs nas/ /sogs kyis bstod/ gau rī sogs kyis dgug zhugs byas la/ slar yang rang gi bum bskyed dang mdun bskyed dngos gzhi'i skabs kyi dbang lha spyan 'dren gyi tshig 'di kho na mdzad/ snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dgas sogs kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /sogs nas/ khyod kyis 'di la dbang bskur stsol/ /ces pa'i bar brjod/ ces gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhī ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje ma la rnam par snang mdzad/ gsang ba'i dkar mo la rin chen 'byung ldan/ chu'i rnal 'byor ma la 'od dpag med/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la don yod grub pa/ gau rī dang pukka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha wa ri la rnam par snang mdzad/ baitta li dang tsaṇḍa li la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma ri dang ḍombhi ni la 'od dpag med/ sa spyod ma la rnam par snang mdzad/ mkha' spyod ma la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ de nas mar me la sogs pa sbar la mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la/ zhes sogs gong bzhin las/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ zhes dang / so so'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ ni rī/ zhes sogs nas/ shapta'i bar gong ltar brjod/ 'di man gyi mchod pa byin rlabs thams cad 'di bzhin du go bar bya'o/ /de nas mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad par bsam la/ dku g.yon par khu tshur gnyis steng 'og tu kha sbyar ste/

dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /oṃ bha ga wa ti badzra nai ratma sa pa ri wa ra oṃ ni rī hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing phyag rgya dkrol te rnam lnga 'dod skor sngon du 'gro bas gong gi mchod yon gyi phyag rgya bcas pa'i mthar se gol gtogs/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang / sngags kyi thog mtha' dang / phyag rgya rnams 'dra ba las/ lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /ni wi te hūm̐ swāhā/ lha rdzas dam pa'i 'thor 'thung 'di/ /sarba saṃ sho ddha ni swāhā/ lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ mahā arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes pas chu bzhi dbul/ de bzhin du me tog la sogs pa so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /oṃ bha ga wa ti sogs dang / oṃ badzra puṣpe pra titstsha swāhā zhes pa 'di man la yang sbyor bar mdzad pa gsung rgyun/ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ de bzhin gzhan rnams 'dra ba las/ 'tshal dag ro ni phan pa dang / /gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog bdag gi sogs gong bzhin las/ dhū pe/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed pa/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel ba/ /a lo ke 'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /gandhe/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yid gar 'ong / /sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag nai wi dyaṃ/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di/ /bcom ldan sogs dang / shapta'i mthar rol chen rgyun dkrol du bya ste/ gaṇḍe ra ṇi sogs brjod/ gos zungs bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srabs 'jam pa yang ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ ces dang /

srab 'jam yangs ba lha yi gos/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog oṃ bha ga wa ti sogs dang / oṃ badzra wasatra ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i khu tshur gnyis kyis na bza' blangs te thog mar smad g.yogs dang / de nas stod g.yogs 'bul ba'i tshul bya zhing / lha re re la phul bar bsam mo/ /de nas g.yon pa'i srin lag gis nang mchod nas blangs te gtor la lha thams cad kyi phyag tu thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba re re byung bar bsam zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i tshul gyis rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma gang yin gyi mtshan nas brjod/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birwa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhu ti/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ bla ma se mkhar chung pa/ zhang dgon pa ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ bla ma ne tse sbal ston/ slob dpon bye ma lung pa/ bla ma shes rab grags/ gnam 'phar ba chos kyi shes rab/ mngon pa ba dbang phyug brtson 'grus/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal ba/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/

yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa 'jam dpa'i dbyangs byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag nos/ chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ am̐ ām̐/ iṃ īṃ/ um̐ ūm̐/ ṛṃ ṝṃ/ l̥ l̥̄ṃ/ eṃ aiṃ/ oṃ auṃ/ am̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lus kyi lha rnams mchod par bsam/ skabs 'dir gtor ma rnams la bar phud bran la/ de nas oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ mahā kā li de wi ye/ dharmā pa la tsa turmu kha ye/ karma nā thā sa pa ri wa ra/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam bral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhes pa gsung rgyun/ 'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dpal mgon chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi gsung ba gsung rgyun yin/ dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / tshandho dang nye ba'i tshandho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung spyod dang nye ba'i 'thung spyod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu rtsa gnyis/

gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i skus 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang / gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skyes gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang / rang gis kyang myang la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3ham̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas dril bu gsum brdungs bya zhing / rang gi snying kha nas lha mo brgyad sprul te mchod par bsam la/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ 'gro ba bud med 'dul gzigs nas/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma gyur gang / /phyag 'tshal pha rol phyin thub la/ /sgyu ma'i phyag rgyas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod la/ spro na skabs 'dir rje btsun rin po che dang / chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa rgyas pa rnams dril sil gdangs dang bcas nas bya'o/ /de nas spos dang bcas pas rdo dril 'dzin pas dril bu bcad btub tu dkrol zhing / bcom ldan rdo rje bdag med ma/

/rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dkyil 'khor thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /mgon po bdag ni 'bri bar 'tshal/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyod la mchod par bya ba'i phyir/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa lags/ /de bas bka' drin mdzad par 'os/ /'gro ba 'khor lo'i don mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sngags kyi lha gzhan gang lags dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /sangs rgyas bstan la dga' ba dang / /gang su rdo rje spyan ldan rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /bdag med ma dpal dkyil 'khor ni/ /yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis/ /'gro ba dag phyir bdag 'bri bas/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad nas kyang / /dkyil 'khor bar bcas thams cad kyis/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas gnang bar mdzod/ ces lan gsum brjod pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod gzhan don rgya che bar gyis shig ces gnang ba thob par bsam/ bum pa sta gon ni/ skabs 'di'am gnas skabs gzhan du'ang rung ste/ gong du bshams pa'i bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du/ bhrum̐ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba kha yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum par sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mu khyud la rdo rje'i rwa ba dang / 'od zer phreng bas bskor ba'i/ zhes pa nas/ phyi phyogs mtshams brgyad gtso mo'i steng dang 'og tu padma dang nyi ma dang / ro'i gdan re re zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ las thams cad pa'i bum par padma dang nyi ma'i gdan/

gdan bcu drug gi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo skar ma'i rnam pa lta bu'i/ a ā sogs a li phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu drug tu gyur pa me long lta bu'i ye shes de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid mar me'i phreng ba lta bu'i ka kha sogs phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bcu drug sogs brjod/ de rnams kyi bar du rim pa bzhin aṃ āṃ sogs sa bon bco lnga dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sa bon hūm̐ rnams las gri gug sngo nag bco lnga sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa'i yu ba la aṃ āṃ sogs nas/ am̐ hūm̐ rnams kyis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa sogs nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo lha mo bco lnga/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas pa'i skur gyur pa ni/ dbus su rdo rje bdag med ma/ shar du rdo rje ma sogs nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar sogs kha 'phang rnams sgrub thabs bzhin la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'phar ma phyi ma'i zhes pa mi gsungs ba/ byang shar du pukka si zhes gsungs te bum pa la 'phar ma phyi ma'i rnam pa med pas so/ /dang / las thams cad pa'i bum par bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur bsten pa/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing / g.yas bskums pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ sogs nas/ thugs khar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad lha mo bco lnga bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas pa'i rnam par/

rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs la mchod pa dang / dgug zhugs bya ba dang / dbang lha spyan drangs la mchod cing bstod la gsol ba btab pa dang / dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas 'debs pa rnams gong bzhin las/ mkha' spyod ma la 'od dpag med/ ces pa'i rjes su/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la don yod grub pa'i dbu brgyan/ ces brjod/ de nas oṃ bha ga wa ti/ zhes sogs re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas phyi mchod/ oṃ aṃ āṃ/ iṃ īṃ/ uṃ ūṃ/ ṛṃ ṝṃ/ l̥ṃ l̥̄ṃ/ eṃ aiṃ/ oṃ auṃ/ am̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha mo bco lnga bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes pas nang mchod phul/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang / 'gro ba bud med sogs kyi mthar/ don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod la/ pad skor byas te gzungs thag blangs te/ bdag gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba dmar po gzungs thag la brten te song ba bum nang gi lha rnams la phog pas lha rnams dmar lam song ste bdag gi dbang du 'dus shing ba spu'i bu kha nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ āḥ aṃ āṃ/ iṃ īṃ/ uṃ ūṃ/ ṛṃ ṝṃ/ l̥ṃ l̥̄ṃ/ eṃ aiṃ/ oṃ auṃ/ aṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes phreng sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dang / a mṛ ta nyer gcig bzla/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas la bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ gzungs thag bsdus la/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces pa'i mthar pad skor sngon du 'gro bas dung chos blangs nas bum pa gnyis su chu thigs re blug ste/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'i mthar/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas gtor ma rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas/ ha hoḥhriḥ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs kyi bdud rtsi byin rlabs bzhin la 'don pa cung zad bsgyur ba brjod la/ mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad du hūm̐ brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ shar lho me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lta/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ de dag kyang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ dbang ldan gyi dur khrod kyi steng gi char chos 'byung la gnas pa'i padma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su sku rdo rje/ shar du dbang phyug lhor lha'i dbang po/ nub tu tshangs pa/ byang du khyab 'jug shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ lho nub tu tshogs kyi bdag po/ nub byang du bhriṃ gi ri ti/ byang shar du gzhon nu karti ka ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ srin po'i dur khrod kyi 'og gi char chos 'byung la gnas pa'i padma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong / nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du nor rgyas/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du padma/ byang shar du padma chen po ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ 'byung po nyer bzhi po 'di dag thams cad padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/

rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas steng gi thams cad lha chen brgyad la thim/ sa steng na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs skyong brgyad la thim/ sa 'og na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad klu chen brgyad la thim/ de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs khar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes se gol gyi sgras spyan drangs/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ badzra gau rī a karṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ badzra tsau rī pra bhe sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badzra baitta lī bandha baṃ/ oṃ badzra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ slar yang snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ thal mo sbyar te/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis/ /khyed kyis 'di la dbang bskur stsol/ /ces gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur nas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas la byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/

gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam la/ oṃ bha ga wa ti mahā ka ru ṇi ka nai ratma sa pa ri wa ra oṃ nī re hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badzra ni wi ti hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ mahā arghaṃ pra titstsha swāhā/ zhes pa rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pa chu bzhi phul/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyis mtshan pa las 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma drangs te gsol bar bsam ste/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ bha ga wa ti sogs nas/ sa pa ri wa ra oṃ ind+ra/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzakkha/ bhu ta/ ba hin/ bā u/ rakkha/ tsand+ra/ su dza/ mā dā/ pappa/ ta la/ pā tā le/ aṣṭa sappa swāhā/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ bhuñdza/ dzigha/ phulla/ dhūspa/ māṃ sa/ piṃ gha/ ambha/ sappa/ kadzdza/ sā da/ khanti/ khu ṇi/ phe ḍa/ gā da/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ a dye nutpanna twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing se gol gdab/ de lta bu gsum mam lnga la sogs pas gtor ma phul la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra bar sbyar la/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapta zhes pas phyi mchod dang / oṃ aṃ āṃ/ iṃ īṃ/ uṃ ūṃ/ ṛṃ ṝṃ/ l̥ṃ l̥̄ṃ/ eṃ aiṃ/ oṃ auṃ/ am̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das 'di nas rdo rje bdag med ma 'di'i bar mi gsungs/ lha mo bco lnga sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes dang / mthe bo'i 'thor mas nang mchod phul la/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo dang / dril bu gsum brdung bya zhing / dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang / 'gro ba bud med sogs dang / mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/

/rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas dgos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /padma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ rdo rje thugs khar bzung dril bu chig brdung bya zhing / lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i༞ 'byung po'i༞ yi dwags༞ sha za'i༞ smyo byed༞ brjed byed༞ mkha' 'gro'i༞ ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /de la sogs te 'byung pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la bsrungs/ /dngos grub kun gyis stong grags mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog ces 'phrin las gzhol/ sgos kyi chos skyong rnams kyi gtor ma dang /

mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs logs nas 'byung ba ltar so so'i phyag len bzhin phul la/ rdo rje'i glu bkra shis bsngo ba smon lam gyi bar du bya'o/ /slob ma dbang bskur gyi sta gon byed dgos yod na skabs 'di'am rjes chog tshar ba'i rjes sogs gang bder bya'o/ /de nas rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ re re'i mgor/ oṃ bha ga wa ti zhes sogs sbyar ba'i chu bzhi nyer spyod rol chen dang bcas pas phyi mchod/ oṃ aṃ āṃ/ iṃ īṃ/ uṃ ūṃ/ ṛṃ ṝṃ/ l̥ l̥̄ṃ/ eṃ aiṃ/ oṃ auṃ/ aṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha mo bco lnga'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes pas nang mchod phul/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang / 'gro ba bu med sogs kyis bstod la/ 'og tu phyi nang yid 'byung bstod pa rnams bya zhes 'byung ba rnams su 'di bzhin shes par bya'o/ /de nas thal mo sbyar te he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum bzla/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /zhes sogs kyi mthar khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe'u chung sbrel/ mdzub mo brkyangs te rtse sprad pa gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor zlog ste/ oṃ badzra u tiṣṭha/ sta gon gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad rnams zhes pa gsung rgyun/ sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar du nam mkhar bzhugs nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod la slar yang phyi nang yid 'byung bstod pa rnams bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ chos skyong gi bris sku sogs gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

bye brag tu yang sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/ de nas rten med pa rnams la/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badzra muḥzhes dang mtheb srin gyis se gol byas la/ ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes dang rang nyid rdo rje bdag med mar gsal ba'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs gsal btab la/ 'gro ba thams cad rdo rje bdag med ma'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa yin no zhes gsungs/ dag go /dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /sogs dge ba bsngo zhing / 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gyi bkra shis sogs bya'o/ /de nas mchod g.yog pa sogs kyis mchod gtor dang tshom bu dman pa rnams bsdu'o/ bri zhing rgyan dgram pa la las thig les bri ba sngon du song nas/ tshon gyis bri ba la thog mar slob dpon gyis thig tshon byin rlabs bya dgos pas slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i dbus su tshon sngon po la rdo rje'i rtses hūm̐ bris/ shar du dkar po la bhrum̐/ lhor ser po la am̐/ nub tu dmar po la dzriṃ/ byang du ljang khu la kham̐ bris/ tshon so so'i steng du kha dog dang mthun pa'i thig skud rnams kyang bzhag mdun du mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma gcig bshams/ rang bdag med ma'i rang bzhin gyi kyai rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis thig tshon bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lnga'i steng du thig tshon sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje/

g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ de bzhin du/ dkar po bhrum̐ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo/ phyag mtshan kun la 'dra/ ser po am̐ las rin 'byung ser po g.yas rin po che/ g.yon 'dra/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo/ dmar po dzriṃ las 'od dpag med dmar po g.yas padma/ g.yon 'dra/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo/ ljang khu kham̐ las don yod grub pa ljang khu g.yas ral gri/ g.yon 'dra/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu/ phyag mtshan 'dra/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ rang gi mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yon pa ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras gnyis hūm̐ yig 'bar bar gyur par bsam la/ mig gi rdzi ma gyen thur du brdab cing / sta gon gyi lha dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kha nas ye shes kyi thig tshon rigs lnga'i rnam pas byon te dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ nam mkha'i lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs lnga so sos dbur brgyan par bsam/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs kyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang / a ka ros phul te/ oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes dang / oṃ badzra su tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes pa nyer gcig re bzla/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis tshon rnams la reg cing yi ge rnams bsub la/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ste de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdul phra rab las grub pa'i thig tshon du gyur/ ces brjod/ thig skud rnams slob dpon gyi lag par blangs te gau rī'i nga rgyal 'dzin pas slob ma la thig skud sngo dkar ser dmar ljang khu rim pas thig sna gtad de brkyangs la/

phan tshun rjes su rtogs pa ste/ /chos kun phan tshun rjes su rtogs/ /chos rnams thams cad shin tu yang / /kun tu 'gro bar chos brjod do/ /zhes brjod cing dang po so so dang / de nas lhan cig tu bsgril bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gnyis su med par gyur par bsam la/ rdo rje la dkris te mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi gtor la bzhag go /de nas slob dpon lang la dkyil 'khor gyi nub nas shar du bltas la/ thig skud dkris pa'i rdo rje rang gi lte ba'i thad du bzung la/ shar nas nub tu phyogs pa'i slob ma la dza dza gnyis brjod cing thig sna gtad/ des kyang dza dza gnyis brjod cing blangs te lte ba'i thad du bzung / slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badzra su tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ nam mkha' gang ba de bzhin gshegs/ /'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags pas/ /khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol bar/ /thig skud sgras ni bskul ma 'debs/ /zhes brjod cing / dang por steng nas 'og tu gcus te nam mkha' la gyen du gdab/ de nas sa la phab ste thig chen brgyad po'i steng du btab pas dkyil 'khor du lam gyis byung bar bsam/ de'i tshe thig skud kyi sgras sangs rgyas thams cad bskul te nam mkha'i khams su byon nas byin gyis brlabs par bsam la gdab bo/ /'debs pa'i go rim ni slob dpon nub dang slob ma shar du gnas pa'i tshangs thig dang po dang / slob dpon lhor slob ma byang du gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa btab/ slob dpon shar lho dang slob ma byang shar du gnas pas shar gyi logs thig slob dpon nub byang slob ma lho nub tu gnas pa'i nub kyi logs thig slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma byang shar du gnas pa'i byang gi logs thig slob dpon shar lho dang slob ma lho nub tu gnas pas lho'i logs thig gdab pa rnams g.yas bskor rgyab 'gros su byed/ de nas slob dpon shar lho de nyid dang slob ma nub byang du gnas pas zur thig dang po gdab/

slob dpon lho nub dang slob ma byang shar du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa gdab ste g.yas bskor du rgyab 'gros spangs te bya/ de kun 'gros ded tshul du bya/ de nas slob dpon nub dang slob ma shar du gnas pas thig skud bsdu/ de nas slob dpon gyis gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor ldog ste/ oṃ badzra be gā kra ma hoḥ zhes brjod pas ye thig nam mkhar bteg nas slob dpon nang du zhugs te/ gzhi bca' pad skor sngon du 'gro bas rdo dril gnyis dkur bsten te/ hi hī zhes brjod cing khro bo'i lta bas sgo bzhi la shar nas g.yas bskor du bltas la sgo rnams dbye bar bsam/ sgo bzhi thad kyi rtsa thig rnams dri bzang gi chus phyis la/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad dbye bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su kha shar du phyogs pas 'dug la/ chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can khams ni sgrol bar byed/ /bdag med ma dpal rgyal chen gyi/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bri bar bya/ /oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya tī kra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing / nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po'i rim pas sgo tshad cig tsam bris dkyil 'khor khang pa dog pa sogs kyi dgos byed byung na/ gzhal yas khang la rtsig pa ljang khu rkyang pa dang / lha mtshan la lha'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshon spungs bkod pa sngon sngags 'chang chen pos lhun grub pho brang du lam 'bras rgyu dbang gnang dus kyi phyag len yin gsungs nas/ kho bos byas 'gyur du gsung ngag thob skabs kyang de bzhin mdzad pa mthong zhing / rgyud sde las kyang bsdus pa'i phyogs la de bzhin rung bar gsungs so/ /la thod pa la sogs pas kha bcad nas steng du rdo rje bzhag ste mchod pa lngas mchod/ dbus kyi phur khung 'og nas dkar po la sogs pa'i rim pas bkang la slob ma la sogs pas dbus nas rim pas bris/

rtsig pa sbrel ran pa na thod pa bsal te sbrel/ mtshan ma brtags la ngan na nam mkha'i lha la mchod gtor phul te 'khyil pas bsrung ngo / /tshon gyi kha dog ni/ dbus kyi nyi ma dmar po/ padma'i lte ba sngon po/ ze 'bru ljang khu/ pad 'dab brgyad kyi phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi dmar po/ me dang rlung ser po/ dbang ldan sngon po/ bden bral ljang khu/ padma'i mu khyud la rdo rje'i rwa gzhi ma sngon po'i steng du ser po'i bris/ ba dang / de'i phyi rol 'od zer phreng bas bskor ba bris/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir padma dang ro'i gdan la gri gug sngo nag re dang / mtshams kyi pad 'dab la padma'i steng du bum pa sngon po thod pas mtshan pa re bris/ 'phar ma gnyis pa'i phyogs mtshams brgyad dang / shar nub kyi sgo khang du padma dang ro'i steng du gri gug sngo nag re bris/ gdung zlum ni bri cha la sna tshogs padma'i rdo rje'i ra ba dang thun mong lta bu las 'os mi 'dug 'di ni sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung rtsom 'phro can gyi dkyil chog na 'di bzhin gsungs 'dug pas the tshom dang log rtog mi dgos pa yin no/ /lha snam phyogs mdog mtshams bzhir bum pa gnyis gnyis te brgyad kyi brgyan pa/ 'dod snam dmar po/ pha gu ser po/ dra ba rnams kyi gzhi nag po/ dra ba dkar po/ shar bu sngon po/ mda' yab khra bo'i phyi thig sngon po/ mun pa glang rgyab nag po/ ka ba rdo rje'i ra phyogs mdog ka rgyan ci mdzes/ rta babs dang po dmar po/ gnyis pa sngon po/ gsum pa ljang khu/ bzhi pa ser po/ padma ci mdzes kyi steng du chos kyi 'khor lo ser po/ de'i steng du gdugs ci mdzes/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags ser po/ khyams ljang khu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i phyi rol padma sna tshogs kyi phyi bcad dmar skya/ dur khrod gzhi nag po la shing / me/ mchod rten/ sprin/ ro dang / keng rus gang shes kyi mtshan ma bris/

phyogs skyong / zhing skyong / klu/ grub thob rnams 'bri shes na dang / tshon spung so so'i mdog dang mthun pa bkod/ dur khrod kyi mtshams brgyad du chu brgyad/ phyi rol tu rdo rje'i gzhi sngon po la rdo rje dkar po bris/ de'i phyi rol tu me ri sna tshogs kyis bskor ba bri'o/ 'di'i dkyil 'khor bri ba'i lag len gsal la go bde ba zhig kho bos logs na byas yod do/ /bris rdzogs nas tshon gyi lhag ma rnams bsdus la/ ye thig gi srad bu bzhag ste mchod pa lngas mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥ thig tshon gyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ sprul pa rnams rang la thim/ de nas spos dang rol mor bcas te slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas rnam rgyal dang / las kyi slob mas las bum thogs nas slob dpon gyi sngon la 'gro zhing / slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum gyi bar phreng sngags brjod cing / rting ma la lha mo bco lnga'i mtshan ma rnams kyi steng du rang rang gi sngags bzlas shing 'bul ba'i stangs ka re byas/ shar du sleb pa dang dkyil 'khor la kha phyogs pas bcom ldan 'das rje btsun bdag med lha mo bco lngas bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod cing phul la rang gi mgor bum pa gtugs la mthar shar ngos su bzhag de nas slob dpon gyis las bum blangs la gong bzhin bskor ba gcig gi ring la 'khyil sngags bzlas shing / lha gnas rnams su 'bul tshul bya/ shar du sleb pa dang / khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pas bdag dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi bar chad thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes brjod de byang shar la nye bar ras bris ltar na thig tshon gyi bya ba rnams dor te/ sngar sta gon gyi lha'i tshom bu bshams pa'i bar ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkrams pa sogs ma gtogs/ gzhan rdul tshon gyi phyogs dang 'dra la/ ras bris la'ang bum pa 'bul bar gsung rab tshad ldan las bshad pas byas kyang shin tu legs shing /

bla ma phal cher gyis phyag len la mi mdzad pas/ ma byas kyang cho ga chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur bar sems/ bzhag go dngos gzhi'i nyin bar dkyil 'khor kyi mthar phyi mchod sta gon bzhin dang / sgos mchod thun mong du phyogs bzhir tshar re bshams/ ji ltar rigs pa'i bzlas gtor mchod pa sogs so so'i phyag len bzhin dang sngon 'gro dang phyi rol gtor ma mchod pa sogs dang / slob ma dbang bskur byed na de la dgos pa'i maṇḍal/ mig dar/ me tog gu gul/ til/ rigs drug gi mchod pa/ dbu rgyan/ rdo rje dril/ mig thur/ me long / 'bud dung / 'khor lo/ po ti/ mda' gzhu/ snam sbyar/ bdud rtsi sogs nye mkho thams cad phyag len bzhin ma tshang ba med par bshams/ de nas dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa ni/ phyi'am red ji ltar 'os pa'i dus su slob dpon 'khor bcas stan la 'dug la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bzlas pa'i bar sta gon bzhin byas la/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i tshe/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ 'khor gyi lha mo rnams gtso mo la thim/ srung 'khor dang gzhal yas khang mi bsdu/ rang gtso mo'i nga rgyal du gnas bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rang gtso mo'i nga rgyal las he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can du gyur/ hi hi zhes brjod pas bgegs rnams bskrad par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas bris pa'i dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ zhes sogs kyis thun mong ba'i srung 'khor bskyed pa nas/ gtso mo'i 'og dang steng rnams su padma dang nyi ma dang ro'i gdan re re dang bcas par gyur/ ces pa'i bar gong sta gon gyi skabs ltar byas la/ de nas/ bdag gis sgom pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo dang mdun bskyed kyi srung ba'i 'khor lo gnyis su med par gyur/

bdag gi bsgom pa'i dur khrod brgyad dang mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad gnyis su med par gyur/ bdag gi bsgom pa'i gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa dang mdun bskyed kyi gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa gnyis su med par gyur/ rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon am̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bkug ste zhal du zhugs/ thugs kha'i am̐ la thim pas lha mo bco lnga'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas bdag med ma dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po sbyangs/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus dbus kyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las bdag med mar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas rdo rje ma dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus nang bskor gyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las rdo rje mar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas gsang ba'i dkar mo dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi nga rgyal dang / ser sna dang / tshor ba'i phung po sbyangs/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus lho'i mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las gsang ba'i dkar mor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas chu'i rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung po sbyangs/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus nub kyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las chu'i rnal 'byor mar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung po sbyangs/

bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus byang gi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las rdo rje mkha' 'gro mar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas pukka sī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi sa'i khams sbyangs/ byams pa tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus byang shar gyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa la pukka sīr gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas ri khrod ma dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi chu'i khams sbyangs/ snying rje tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus shar lho'i mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa la ri khrod mar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas gdol pa mo dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi me'i khams sbyangs/ dga' ba tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus lho nub kyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las gdol pa mor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas g.yung mo dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi rlung gi khams sbyangs/ btang snyoms tshad med la bkod/ tshur 'dus nub byang gi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las g.yung mor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas gau rī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi yul gzugs kyi skye mched sbyangs sangs rgyas thams cad gzugs kyi bde bas mchod/ tshur 'dus shar gyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las gau rīr gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas tsau rī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi yul sgra'i skye mched sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad sgra'i bde bas mchod/ tshur 'dus lho'i mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las tsau rīr gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas baitta li dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi yul dri'i skye mched sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad dri'i bde bas mchod/ tshur 'dus nub kyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las baitta līr gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas ghasma rī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi yul ro'i skye mched sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad ro'i bde bas mchod/ tshur 'dus byang gi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las ghasma rīr gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas sa spyod ma dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi yul reg bya'i skye mched sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad reg bya'i bde bas mchod/ tshur 'dus 'og gi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las sa spyod mar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas mkha' spyod ma dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi yul chos kyi skye mched sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad chos kyi bde bas mchod/ tshur 'dus steng gi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las mkha' spyod mar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas gzhal yas khang dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi ma dag pa snod kyi 'jig rten sbyangs/ dag pa byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi rtogs pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus gzhal yas khang la thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas dur khrod brgyad dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi bu ga dgu dang / 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rtog pa sbyangs/ sgyu ma la sogs pa'i dpe brgyad dang / 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba la bkod/ tshur 'dus dur khrod brgyad la thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas srung ba'i 'khor lo dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshar bcad/ lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ lha de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ sogs skye mched sku gsum thugs byin gyis brlabs/ dngos gzhi dang po'i tshe lag g.yas rdo rje gsor/

g.yon pa dril bu drag tu dkrol la rol chen mdzad/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis sta gon gyi lha'i phyi 'brang gi bgegs thams cad bskrad/ ces dang / ngag tu phreng sngags brjod cing phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ e hye hi bha ga wa ti badzra nai ratma sa pa rī wā ra/ zhes sogs lan gcig sngon du 'gro ba'i chu bzhis mchod/ gau rī sogs kyis dgug gzhug bya/ 'di dngos gzhi gnyis pa man la mi dgos/ de nas rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rje btsun lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ gong sta gon gyi skabs ltar mchod bstod byas la gau rī la sogs pas dgug gzhug bya'o/ /slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha spyan drangs la/ de la mchod pa bstod pa/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas 'debs pa rnams lha sta gon bzhin bya/ de nas lha rnams la dmigs la/ oṃ badzra nai ratma/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sogs lha sta gon gyi lha bskyed pa'i skabs su bshad pa'i lha mo so so'i sngags mgor sbyar ba'i yi ge brgya pa lan bco lnga bco lnga bzlas gtso bo la brgya rtsa dang 'khor rnams la nyer gcig re bzlas kyang rung / pa'i rjes su thal mo sbyar la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa zhes pa gsung rgyun/ stsal du gsol/ zhes pa'i mthar/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can du gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te/

chu bzhi/ nyer spyod/ gos zung / nang mchod/ yid byung / bstod pa rnams sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin byas la rang gi lce la bdud rtsi myang ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pa'i snying kha'i am̐/ lha mo thams cad kyi ngo bo mnyes par bsam ste/ 'di ma chad pa gal che'o/ /de nas bsgrub grogs gcig sngags phreng sngags bzla zhing dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug la/ rang nyid grogs dang bcas pa bsgrub khang gi phyi'am/ dkyil 'khor dang yol ba'i bar du chod pa'i sar phyin la/ ji ltar 'os pa'i stegs la gtor ma gcig dang / de'i g.yas su chu bzhi dang / g.yon du nyer spyod lnga mdun nas rgyab tu bsgrengs tshar du bshams/ mdun du nang mchod kyang bsham la/ gtor ma chab kyis bran te/ rdo rje dril bu dang bcas te gtor ma byin rlabs sgrub thabs kyi bdud rtsi byin rlabs bzhin byas la 'don pa cung zad bsgyur ro/ /gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar e e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum gsum brtsegs kyi nang du paṃ paṃ paṃ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa re re/ steng gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i padma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su sku rdo rje/ shar du dbang phyug chen po sogs dang / bar gyi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i padma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ zhes sogs nas/ dbang bskur ba'i bar sta gon gyi gtor bsngo bzhin dang 'dra ba las/ sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ thugs rdo rje phyogs skyong brgyad dang bcas pa la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ ces pa'i mthar/ oṃ ni rī zhes sogs kyi chu bzhi dang / oṃ inda dza ma/ zhes sogs kyi gtor ma phul la/ puṣpe sogs kyi phyi mchod/

nang mchod/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sogs nas bar chad bsrung ba dang / de nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang stongs grogs mdzod cig ces pa'i bar sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs bzhin brjod/ de nas dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol bzhin pa la rdo rje'i glu/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa/ smon lam rigs su skyes dang rnams bya/ de'i tshe mchod g.yog pas zhal zas nas brtsams te/ 'thor 'thung gi bar gyi mchod pa rnams g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gtor snod du bsdus la/ slob dpon gyis mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ hrīḥbi shudhaḥsarba dharma sarba pā paṃ ni tsa sya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de'i tshe slob mas mchod yon gyi chu'i gtor snod la bskor te lhag ma gtor ma 'gro phyogs su bsgrengs la/ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya/ sogs gur nas 'byung ba'i yi ge brgya pa dang / ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /sogs kyi mthar/ badzra mu/ zhes dang lag pa g.yas sa la reg gtor mgron rnams bsgrub khang gi phyogs mtshams rnams su bzhugs nas dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i las mdzod/ ces brjod cing bsam/ bsgrub mchod rjes ma'i nyin ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ zhes brjod/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas rang dang mchod g.yog gi gnas bdud rtsi rang gi lce dang mchod g.yog pa'i mgo la bzhag go /gsum bsrung la gtor ma rol mo dang bcas pas phyi rol gyi sa gtsang sar dor/ phreng sngags bzla zhing rol mo drag brdung dang bcas pas slob dpon gyis rting mnan log ste dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i nang du bslebs pa dang rol mo rgyun chags dang yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing / bshong na dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gsum la sogs pa bya/ mi bshong na 'dod snam gyi steng nas byas par bsam la/ mthar dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/

bdag ma 'byor ba dang gsungs pa gsung rgyun la yod/ las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / sems bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang du gyur pa dang / cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa dang / mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang / nyams pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub pa la skyon du gyur pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad de lhag chad kha skong par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje dril bu 'dzin bzhin pas phyag byas la gral la 'dug go /'jug cing dbang blangs pa la/ thog mar skabs 'dir las kyi rdo rjes rnam rgyal dang las bum gyi chu cung zad bsres la dpon slob rnams la dung chos su phul la/ rnam rgyal slob dpon gyi g.yas dang las bum g.yon du bzhag pa ni phyag stabs bde ba'i ched du yin la/ bum pa bsgrub pa'i skabs su rnam rgyal slob dpon gyi g.yon/ las kyi rdo rje slob dpon la kha phyogs pa'i g.yas dang / las bum slob dpon gyi g.yas/ las kyi rdo rje slob dpon la kha phyogs pa'i g.yon phyogs su bshoms pa ni bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sogs gtso bo'i g.yon du 'ong ba'i dbang 'di yin no/ /zhes sems dpa' chen po'i gsung rgyun zin bris byas pa'i sngon gyi dkyil chog 'ga' zhig tu 'byung ba lags/ bdag nyid 'jug pa ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi 'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing las bum gyi chus kha bshal mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla mar mos te/ bla mas mdzad dgos pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang / dbang rdzas 'grems pa rnams de'i thugs kha nas bye ba'i he ru ka zhig gis mdzad par bsam zhing dngos su thams cad rang nyid kyis byas la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal bdun ma phul la/

bdag med ma yi mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ /dga' chen khyod bdag sogs yab kyi skabs bzhin gsum brjod/ sdom pa bsgrags pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa 'o/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /blo chen khyod kyis gzung bya ste/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes su bshad/ /slob dpon khyod kyis gzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bya/ /'di ni padma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus byos/ /de las gzhan yang bcu bzhi ni/ /phas pham par ni rab tu bshad/ /spangs shing 'dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes bshad do/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin ni bzla bar bya/ /gal te nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ /kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang mi blang ngo / /'dod la log par mi spyad cing / /brdzun du smra bar mi bya 'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yi/ /chang ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /sems can don phyir ma gtogs pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spongs/ /dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing / /rnal 'byor pa kun bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus par ni rjes su skyongs/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab phyogs min/

/'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spong / /rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ /khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya zhing / /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'goms par mi bya 'o/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par bshad/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /rjes mthun sdom pa rgya cher ni/ /gsang ba'i rgyud la rab tu bshad/ /ces lan gcig bsgrags/ 'di bdag 'jug gi tshe ma byas kyang rung ngo / /de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ongs spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces pas rgyun bshags lan gsum dang / sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/

/rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma dbyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /ces rigs lnga'i sdom gzung lan gsum byas la/ āḥkhaṃ wi ra hūm̐/ zhes pas mig ras 'ching tshul bya/ sngags de nyid kyi me tog gi phreng ba blangs/ gtso bo'i thugs kha nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te/ bdag nyid dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par bsam la/ a mṛ ta bzla zhing las bum gyi chus gtor te phyi'i bgegs bskrad/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod cing bdud rtsi lce la bzhag pas nang gi bar chad bsrung la/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhes dang / skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes pas dris lan dang po dang / de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ zhes dang / sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes pas dris lan gnyis pa byas par bsam la/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta ud pā da ya mi/ zhes dang / snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ su ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ hoḥ sidhya badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ gsang bar gdams pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su rab tu zhugs kyis/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no/ /zhes brjod/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes pas gtso bo'i drung du khrid par bsam la dkyil 'khor la mgo dud pa tsam bya/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bo dang / ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje snying kha dang / bdag med ma dpal deng khyod kyis/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/ /zhes dang / slar yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo 'gem par 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod/ gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rnam rgyal gyi chu dang bdud rtsi dung chos su blug pa'am/ bdag 'jug gi skabs 'dir nang mchod nas myang la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ zhes brjod/ bla ma'i bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bo dang / deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi dpal rdo rje bdag med ma nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bya ba de khyod kyi bya dgos so/ /nga la yang brnyas par ma byed cig byas na ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba pa chen por ltung bar 'gyur ta re/

zhes pas dam la bzhag maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha dad med pa la dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ rang nyid rdo rje bdag med ma'i rang bzhin he ru kar gsal ba'i rkang pa'i gnyis kyi zhes pa gsung 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu gdungs pa lta bu chang zung thur du bstan cing / mchog ma gnyis gyen du bstan pa la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du rkang pa gnyis bgrad nas gnas pa'i rkang mthil gnyis su rkang mthil gnyis su zhes pa gsung rgyun yin/ yi ge dzhaiṃ ljang khu drag cing bzod par dka' ba re re/ sum mdor ram̐ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po ram̐ dang me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ snying khar laṃ las byung ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhi rdo rje phyed pa dang lte ba la lam gyis mtshan pa/ zhes pa gsung rgyun/ rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par baṃ las byung ba'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa la āḥyis mtshan ma/ spyi bor yaṃ las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba 'khrig pa lta bu la haḥyis mtshan pa/ gtso bo'i mdun bskyed kyi zhes pa gsung rgyun/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas rkang mthil gyi dzhaiṃ me 'bar/ long bu gnyis kyi rtsa nang nas zhugs/ brla'i rtsa bo che na yar dmar khyug khyug song / sum mdor gzhi gnas kyi me dang khrug chil te 'dres pas drag tu 'bar bas snying kha'i sa bsros/ des mgrin pa'i chu skol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas spyi bo'i rlung g.yos thur du bus pas mgrin pa'i chu'i zegs ma snying kha'i sa la babs pas bde ba dang /

lte ba'i me 'bar ba'i drod skyes te snying gar bde drod 'dzom pa la brten nas lhan gcig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs rkang 'og gi rlung gis yar bteg spyi bo'i rlung gis thur la mnan te lus bar snang du 'dar yed yed gnas pa'i tshe/ spyi bo dang ba spu'i bu ga nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kha ba babs pa bzhin sib sib thim par gyur/ ces gtso bos mdzad par bsam zhing / rdo rje gsor dril bu drag tu dkrol zhing rol mo drag tu byas la/ hūm̐ āḥha/ dzhaiṃ/ zhes dang / a be sha ya a be sha ya/ stambha ya stambha ya/ ra ra/ ra ra/ tsā la ya/ tsā la ya/ hūm̐ āḥha/ dzhaiṃ zhes mang du brjod/ bdag 'jug gi tshe rdzas kyi dud pa mi mdzad/ brtan pa'i phyir rang gi spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste/ tiṣṭha badzra/ zhes brjod/ dril bu bcad btub tu dkrol la/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /bdag med ma dpal grong khyer mchog snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang / /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni de bzhin shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ nam mkha'i kha dog brtag pa la/ dkar ser dmar nag ljang khu'am sna tshogs rnams mthong na zhi rgyas dbang drag sna tshogs rnams 'grub bo snyam du dran par byas la dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol zhing / zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces sogs bdag bskyed bzhin bstod de/ gtso bo'i dbu la me tog phul bar bsam la/ oṃ pra ttitstsha badzra hoḥ zhes brjod cing dbul/ he ru ka des/

oṃ pra tti gṛhṇa satwaṃ i maṃ satwa mahā ba la zhes me tog phog pa'i lha la zhus pas/ lha des me tog de rang gi spyi bor bzhag par bsam ste/ oṃ bdag med ma dpal deng khyod kyis/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /nam̐ nai ratma pa shya/ zhes pas mig ras dkrol bar bsam la/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /me tog gang du lhungs gyur pa/ /de ni khyod kyi bdag med ma/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu skyed/ /khyod kyang sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ /zhes dang / lha ngo sprad pa ste dkyil 'khor bstan pa ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mthong bar mos la/ bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas par mos te/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag bzhugs gsol/ /oṃ/ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong / /oṃ/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /sa ma ya hoḥhoḥhoḥ zhes brjod/ maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab ces sogs nas/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs dang / byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri padma nyi ma ro'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'i sku can du gyur pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/

g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ mtha' skor du mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ nī ri sogs chu bzhis sbyangs la/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sdig pa'i sa bon kaṃ yig gi rnam pas sna sgor thon nas mdun gyi til la thim par gyur pa/ he ru kas g.yas su mes bsreg shing / g.yon du chur dor bar bsam la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ya badzra satwa sya/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na swāhā/ zhes brjod cing g.yas pas g.yas dang / g.yon pas g.yon dang / gnyis ka g.yas su bskor ba me dang chur dor bar bsam/ de bzhin du/ oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭ/ ces brjod pas bskor zhing dor te gnyis ka'ang lan gsum gsum byas nas me chur dor bar bsam ste/ bdag gi byur dang skal ba ngan pa dang bkra mi shis pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig ces brjod dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyis bdag la bkra shis mdzad par bsam la/ dril bu sil zhing me tog 'di phyag len la mi mdzad/ gtor/ mchod g.yog pas rnam rgyal bum pa bteg ste/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas padma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyi mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin/ /bdag cag dpon slob ces gsungs/ 'khor dang bcas pa rnams spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig
