ces brjod/ dbang dngos la gnyis las/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang / bdag gi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang / dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ zhes pa nas/ thugs khar thugs rdo rje/ thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥlan gnyis/ spro na so so'i sngags rgyas bstim/ slar yang thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas dbang rdzas la dbang bskur zhes pa gsung rgyun/ kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyi/ /khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /ces gsol ba btab pas/

sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bcas te dbang bskur bas dbang gi chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang / bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying kha yan chad gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang / mchog tu bde ba chen po bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra a lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang bskur ba thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang / bdag gi tshor ba'i phung po dang / dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ am̐ las rin po che'i am̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rin po che/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma nas thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/

thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ lan gnyis sam/ spro na so so'i sngags rgyas bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /sogs gsol ba btab/ oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas la dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs tshig gsum gong bzhin la/ rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ ratna mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badzra ra ga ta/ badzra sha li hoḥ.oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badzra puṣpe nas/ oṃ badzra nai wi dyaṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bar 'dra/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas/ bdag gi 'du shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dzam̐ las padma dzam̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas padma dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/

gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'od dpag med yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gnyis sam spro na so so'i sngags rgyas bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs/ /oṃ mahā badzra hūm̐/ oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs 'dra/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang / bdag gi 'du byed kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/

gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ sogs dang / thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad don yod grub pa yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gnyis sam spro na so so'i sngags rgyas bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsi hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs dang / oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya satwam̐/ oṃ badzri bhā wa sogs dang / zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badzra nai wi dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ gi bar brjod/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba bsgrub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang / bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrum̐ las 'khor lo bhrum̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas 'khor lo dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/

sogs nas/ thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes sam/ spro na so so'i sngags rgyas bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sogs dang / oṃ badzra satwa satwam̐/ badzra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye che ge mo'i thad du rang gi mtshan nas bton te dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ nas oṃ badzra nai wi dya āḥhūm̐/ gi bar brjod/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba/ /gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /chos rnams rang bzhin rnyog med dag /sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar gyis/ /chos can gyi snang ba gang dang gang snang ba thams cad tha mal pa ma yin pa lhag pa'i lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin yin no snyam du bsam mo/ /oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang / bdag gi phung po lnga'i chos nyid la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag gi phung po lnga'i chos nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/

gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ sogs/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'am/ spro na so so'i sngags rgyas bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ de nas hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa lag pa g.yas su gnang bar bsam la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa mā ya tiṣṭha e ṣa satwaṃ dhā rā ya mi badzra satwa hi hi hi hūm̐/ rdo rje gsor te snying khar bzung nas/ deng phyin chad tha mal pa'i spyod pa thul la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin la gnas par gyis shig ces gsungs par bsam/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung zhig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs gong dang 'dra/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ /mgon pos bdag la stsal nas kyang / /'khor lo'i lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon phrin las yongs su bzung / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa'ang bla na med pa stsol/ /lan gsum gsol ba btab/ rang nyid dbang stegs kyi steng rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam pas 'khod par bsam la/ 'di de sogs sngags dang bcas pas g.yas su rdo rje gnang bar bsam pa snying khar bzung ste/

thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /oṃ mahā badzra hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ rdo rje 'di ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad bral ba rig stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo mtshon par byed pa yin la/ rang gi sems thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nges don gyi rdo rje yin no snyam du bsam/ de nas a las byung ba'i dril bu lha nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa lag pa g.yon du gnang bar bsam la/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /ces dang / lag pa g.yon pas dkrol te/ dku g.yon par kha gyen du phyogs pas bzung la/ a/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa/ /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badzra gaṇḍe āḥ dril bu 'di ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong pa mtshon par byed pa yin la/ rang gi ngag srid pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa nges don gyi dril bu yin no snyam du bsam/ de nas/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ sogs dang / thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'chang chen po yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes sam/ spro na so so'i sngags rgyas bstim/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes brjod/ lag pa gnyis snying gar bsnol la/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po 'dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni khyod kyis longs/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod pa pa ni sten bzhin du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i sbyor bas/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su grags/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /zhes brjod de tha mal pa'i bde ba ni ma dag pa'o/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal zad par bya ba'i phyir rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor bya ste/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la longs spyod cig thams cad la mchod par gyis shig 'di'i rdo rje 'chang chen po kha sbyor yan lag bdun gyi sku thob pa las mi 'da'o/ /de bas na ting nge 'dzin 'di la gnas pa gyis shig ces gsungs par bsam/ brtan pa'i ched du bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar bsam/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yis/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes sogs nas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag ces pa'i bar mi bskyod pa chu dbang gi skabs ltar brjod la/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbu rgyan zhes pa gsung rgyun la yod/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/

oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor zhing rab gnas byas la/ puṣpe sogs lngas mchod de/ dril bu dang dbu rgyan sogs bzhag la/ de ltar na/ khyod la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbang bskur ba 'dis khyod kyi phung po dang khams dang skye mched kyi dri ma thams cad dag par byas pa yin pas de thams cad rang gi sems su 'du la/ sems de nyid yang zhes gsungs/ mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' yin par rang gi sems rnam par dag pa nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yin te/ gzhal yas khang pa ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bo yin la/ de yang rang gi sems rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhes rten gyi rnam par dag pa dang / gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /tshor ba la yang dkar mor brjod/ /'du shes chu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnam shes phung po'i tshul gyis ni/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma gnas so/ /zhe sdang zhes bshad rdo rje ma/ /'dod chags chu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /phrag dog rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /ser sna gsang ba'i dkar mo nyid/ /gti mug de bzhin rdo rjer bshad/ /sa ni pukka si zhes bshad/ /chu khams rngon pa ma zhes brjod/ /me ni gtum mor shes par bya/ /rlung ni g.yung mor rab tu grags/ /gzugs la gau rīr rtag tu bshad/ /sgra la chom rkun ma rab grags/ /dri yi cha la ro langs ma/ /ro la ghasma ri rab grags/ /reg la sa spyod ma zhes brjod/ /chos kyi dbyings la mkha' spyod ma/ /zhes lha'i rnam dag dang / mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ /rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ /sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ /kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes dbang po'i dag pa dang / nga rgyal la sogs skyon drug rnams/ /gcod phyir gri gug rnam par 'dzin/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam rtog gi

/mgo bo padma'i snod du ni/ /bdud rnams rnam pa bzhi yi khrag /dngos grub phyir ni btung bar bya/ /stong pa'i rnam pas kha ṭwam̐ ga /thabs kyi ro ni rnam par brtag /ces phyag mtshan gyi dag pa dang / spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng bar rin chen bdag lag par rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /ska rags la ni don yod gnas/ /yan lag kun la rdo 'dzin mgon/ /zhes rgyan cha'i dag pa rnams dran par bya'o zhes gsungs par bsam/ de bas na sems nyid ni byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bo gzhal yas khang pa yin la/ sems la phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa du mar snang ba ni gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha yin te/ de yang phung po lnga ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan/ 'byung ba bzhi ni rig ma'i gdan/ nang gi skye mched ni byang chub sems dpa'i gdan/ phyi'i skye mched ni lha mo'i gdan/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa la sogs pa zad par byed pa ni khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan yin no/ /zhes brjod cing gsungs par bsams/ lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ gar skor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dku 'gram g.yas g.yon du bzhag ste/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras dang bcas la rnam rol zhing / /rdo rje snyems ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dga' ston bde ba'i mchod par gyis/ /āḥde bzhin du khu tshur gnyis kha 'gram g.yas g.yon du bzhag ste/ sgeg dang bcas pa phreng ba 'phang / /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /de ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /oṃ/ khu tshur gnyis kha nas 'byin pa ltar byas te/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya/ /de yis bde gshegs dngos grub ni/ /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /gīḥrdo rje thal mo spyi bor bskor ba byas te/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyi ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/

/sangs rgyas 'du ba'i phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis/ /hoḥ khu tshur gnyis bdug spos kyi phyag rgya dang / rdzogs sangs rgyas spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ /hūm̐/ me tog gi phyag rgya dang / sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur/ /bhrum̐/ mar me'i phyag rgya dang / chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru/ /sems can ma rig ldongs pa la/ /ye shes sgron mes gsal bar gyis/ /pra/ g.yon pas dung chos 'dzin cing g.yas pas dri bzang byug pa'i tshul dang / rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ /ga zhes brjod/ sems can gyi don rgya che bar bya ba'i rjes gnang ni/ yum gyi phreng 'di bdag 'jug tu mi mdzad/ sngags tshar gcig brjod la/ des bsngags pa'i mig thur ram/ med na rdo rjes mig 'byed pa'i tshul bya zhing / ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling thog gsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /ling thog rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badzra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hriḥ/praṃ/ zhes brjod/ me long len pa'i tshul bya zhing / chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni nyams med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skyes/ /zhes brjod/ āḥlas skyes pa'i dril bu blangs te/ āḥ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/

/kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /zhes brjod cing dkrol/ hoḥ zhes brjod cing mda' gzhu byin nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par byos shig ces gsungs par bsam zhing / phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og gnyis su mda' 'phen tshul bya'o/ /me long rdo rje dang bcas pa len tshul byas la/ nam̐ nai ratma/ bdag med ma dpal me long ltar/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /bdag med ma yi rang bzhin gtso/ /gang yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems ni 'di yin par shes par gyis shig ces brjod/ chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ni/ oṃ badzra he tu maṃ/ zhes pas rkang pa'i 'og tu 'khor lo/ oṃ badzra bhā ga raṃ/ zhes pas lag pa g.yas su dung / oṃ badzra gandhe āḥ zhes pas g.yon du dril bu/ āḥzhes pas lag ngar gyi steng du po ti rnams byin par bsam la/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /khyod kyis the tshom dgos med pa/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med par/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /sngags brjod tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /ces brjod/ gar bskor sngon du 'gro bas rigs lnga so so'i phyag chen rnams rim bzhin bcas la/ sems can kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes pa'i tshe rnam snang dang / de bzhin du tshig rkang dang po gsum 'dra ba las/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes dang rin 'byung / padma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes dang 'od dpag med/

sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes dang don grub kyi phyag rgya byas la/ de ltar na khyod kyis sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ padma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rnams bskor la/ khyod kyis sems can thams cad la chos kyi dung bus/ sgra sgrogs/ bshad pa gyis shig ces gnang ba sbyin par bsam/ de ltar na bskyed pa rdul tshon nam/ ras bris gang yin skabs dang sbyar la/ dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma dag dam tshig gi rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba la dbang bar byas/ brda' lnga bsdus rtse mo mnan pa/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa/ /khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can gsad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes/ /zhes pas bstod/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya bsgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung / /ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /byings ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcing la/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs gar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs rgyud byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nor bu'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le mu tig gi rdog ma lta bu bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag par bsam zhing /

dngos su bdud rtsi myang zhing / ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /zhes sogs brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥzhes brjod cing myang la/ mgrin pa nas thig le 'phel te lus thams cad gang bas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa thams cad 'gags te/ gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas bsrungs te mig ras phye bar bsam mo/ /de nas bla ma shākya thub pa'i rnam par 'phos nas chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba lta bu dang / g.yas pas rdor dril 'dzin pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas rang gi gsang mtshan nas ston par bsam la/ dngos su rang gi de ltar byas te/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /bdag med ma dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las ston/ /kye dpal che ge mo rang gi gsang ming nas brjod/ rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sa 'og sa steng / sa bla rnams su bhur bhu wa swāhā/ gang la ngas lung bstan pa'i 'di la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs pa zhes pa gsung rgyun/ 'khor lo dang bcas rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad de pa 'di ni zhes gsungs/ sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/ /zhes brjod/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag dam tshig sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu bsten pa la dbang bar byas/ brda' mtheb srin e la rig byed gcig lam bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul la bstod pa dang gsol btab gong ltar byas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcing /

bla mas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya ma zhig bdag la gtad par bsam ste/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ /zhes gnang ba des/ bshang gci dag ni bza' ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par bu spro 'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i padmar 'o byed par/ /bu khyod ci dga' spro gyur tam/ /zhes dri ba byas par bsam/ bdag gis kyang / bshang gci dag ni bza' ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par cis mi spro/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i padmar 'o byed par/ /bdag nyid ci dgar spro gyur to/ /zhes lan btab pas/ phyag rgya de dges nas lus gcer bur phyung ste/ chu skyes gur gum la sogs pas dri zhim par byas/ rtsa mchog tu rgyas pa'i padma ston bzhin du padma'i che ba brjod par bsam ste/ e ma nga yi padma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gal te cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na bdag 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa/ /padmar bya bar ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /des na mchog gi dngos grub med/ /satwaṃ padma bhañdza mokṣa hoḥ zhes gsungs shing rig ma rang gi pang du byon par bsam/ rang nyid kyai rdo rje dang rig ma bdag med mar gsal ba/ lus lha'i 'du shes/ mkha' gsang bsnol mar byin gyis brlabs pa/ ngag sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sngon du bya'o snyam pa yid chos kyi 'du shes gsum dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas yum gyi mkha' a las padma a yis mtshan pa/ rang nyid kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi mes spyi bo'i haṃ zhu/

byang sems spyi bo nas mgrin par byon pas dga' ba/ snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/ lte bar byon pas dga' bral/ mkha' gsang gnyis kyi rtser byang sems dkar dmar 'dzom pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas snyam du bsam pa yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi dang / slar hūm̐ zhes brjod cing rlung gi nus pas byang sems dkar dmar gnyis rang rang gi gsang gnas nas yar drangs te so so'i lte bar byon pas dga' ba/ snying khar byon pas mchog dga'/ mgrin par byon pas dga' bral/ spyi bor byon pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas snyam du bsam la/ de'i tshe lus thams cad la rtsas khyab/ rtsa thams cad la byang chub sems kyis khyab/ de thams cad la bde bas khyab ste/ bde stong zung 'jug gi rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag ste/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi bsgom/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod gdong ras phye bar bsam/ de nas lam gyi dbugs dbyung ba ni/ slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing / /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /spun la smad pa nyid mi bya/ /sems can rnams la sdug byams dang / /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /bdag gzhan chos la smad mi bya/ /skal med de nyid gtam mi bya/ /bdag gi lus la nges mi dmad/ /chos la yid gnyis spang bya zhing / /gdug la byams pa nyid mi bya/ /chos nyid tshad ni gzung mi bya/ /skal ldan sems can spang mi bya/ /dam tshig rtag tu bskyang bar bya/ /bud med nyid la smad mi bya/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dkon mchog gsum ni spang mi bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ /rdo rje dril bu gzung bar bya/ /gtsug tor rtag tu bcang bar bya/ /rtag tu sbyin sreg dgang bar bya/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya/ /rtag tu bde gshegs rab gnas bya/ /'byung po che la gtor ma sbyin/ /phyag rgya bcing ba rnam spang zhing / /mchod rten las ni mi bya ste/

/rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs lus kyi las/ /rmi lam du yang mi bya 'o/ /slob dpon gzhan la phyag mi bya/ /bla ma'i rgan rab phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag par rgyun du sngags bzla zhing / /bsam gtan nyid kyang rnam par spyad/ /rtag tu slob ma bsdu bya zhing / /rtag pa ru ni bshad par gyis/ /rtag tu sems can bskyang bar bya/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas cher mnyes bya/ /dzambha la la chu sbyin zhing / /las rnams thams cad yang dag spyad/ /bye ma'i las la mchod rten yang / /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bya/ /zhes brjod cing gsung par bsam la de don yid la dran par bya'o/ /'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung ba ni/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral ba/ /khyod ni nam yang mi bya 'o/ /mahā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pa de'i don ni/ dad pa chen pos lha dang bla ma la chags pa/ snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don la chags pa/ shes rab chen pos chos kyi de kho na nyid la chags pa bde ba chen pos thig le la chags pa ste chags pa 'di bzhi dang bral ba las sdig che ba med pas/ 'di bzhi dang ma bral ba la bslab par bya'o/ /ces gsung rgyun yin no/ /zhes bya ba 'di gsum dang bral na sdig che ba yin pas/ 'di gsum dang ma bral ba la bslab par bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la rkyang phyag lan gsum byas pa'i tha ma la dkyil 'khor pa rnams la lus phul bar bsam la/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ /zhes phul bas/ de rnams kyis 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung bar bsam ste/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris/ /khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/

/de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /khams gsum na ni rgyal srid che/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bdud tshogs kun las nges rgyal te/ /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /zhes brjod/ de ltar na phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag dam tshig bud med la mi smod pa la/ brda' byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul la/ mgon po thugs rje cher ldan pas/ /dbang bskur gsum po bdag la gnang / /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /bzhi pa yang ni byin gyis rlobs/ /lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcings bar bsam mo/ /ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ /khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /zhes gsungs par bsam ste/ de'i don rang nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du snang ba sprul sku/ sems kyis phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyor ba las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du shar ba longs sku/ lha sku bde chen gyi rnam par snang tsam de nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba chos sku/ de gsum dbyer mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ mdor na sems kyis shis ci yang ma yin pa/ gdangs bde chen du ma 'gags pa/ rtsal lha skur 'char ba/ bsgom bya sgom byed las 'das pa nam mkha' lta bur shes par byas la/ dbang gsum pa'i ye shes dang rang sems dbyer med du bsres te zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po 'dzin med kyi ngang la cung zad mnyam par gzhag oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis mig ras phye bar bsam/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/

/btsud pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ /de ring sdig las rnam grol 'gyur/ /de ring khyod rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod ma yin/ /mi thub pa dang mi 'chi bas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /zhes brjod cing gsungs par bsam la/ don yid la dran pa'i sgo nas gzengs bstod do/ /de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag dam tshig dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig bsrung ba la dbang / brda' mdzub mos nam mkha' mtshon pa/ lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ gnas skabs de dag tu thob pa'i dam tshig la bsrung sdom bgyid snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum dang / dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal rgyas pa phul te/ lus longs spyod thams cad kyang phul te cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te zhes sogs pa lan gsum brjod/ de nas dam tshig gsum gyi glu blangs pa ni/ gang du dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / gang gis bskur ba'i slob dpon dang / gang la bskur ba'i slob ma ste/ 'khor gsum ka snang la rang bzhin med pa skye med bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa/ de'i mthus bdag gis kyang de ltar rtogs par gyur cig snyam pas tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su rdo rje gsor/ dril bu bcad gtub tu dkrol te/ oṃ/ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /kyai yi 'di la 'don pa bsgyur dgos pa bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab gang na yang ma bshad pa 'don pa bsgyur mi dgos so/

/rdo rje bdag grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag bsgrub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa ste/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems su bdag bsgrub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag bsgrub mdzod/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la zhugs/ /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid/ /'dod chags mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog /ces lan gcig dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du snang ba yang chos sku stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa las byung ba'i byin gyis rlabs pa dang / slob dpon gyis kyang de ltar rtogs pa'i byin rlabs kyis slob ma rnams kyis kyang rdul tshon nam mtshan ma tsam ma yin par snang la rang bzhin med pa gzugs kyi skur mthong bar gyur cig snyam pas/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa/ /bden pa de yis mgon bdag la/ /khyod kyis 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung / /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces bden stobs brjod/ skabs 'dir sngar sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar gyi cho gas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma rnams 'bul lo/

/de nas rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ re re'i mgor oṃ bhā ga wa ti zhes sogs sbyar ba'i chu bzhi nyer spyod rol chen dang bcas pas phyi mchod/ oṃ aṃ āṃ/ iṃ īṃ/ uṃ ūṃ/ ṛṃ ṝṃ/ l̥ṃ l̥̄ṃ/ eṃ aiṃ/ oṃ auṃ/ aṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha mo bco lnga'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes pas nang mchod phul/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang / 'gro ba bud med sogs kyis bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dang / he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol lo/ /ras bris yin na/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i zhes sogs kyi mthar/ khyad par du yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes sogs dang / rdul tshon gyi phyogs yin na gshegs gsol gyi nyin ma gtogs nyi ma snga ma rnams la gong gi khyad par du yang zhes pa'i rjes su/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas pa'i bar du/ zhes sogs brjod la/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba dang / dam tshig pa bsdu ba sogs sta gon gyi skabs ltar bya'o/ /rdul tshon gshegs gsol gyi nyin rjes chog gi tshe bum pa rnams 'khyam gyi steng bzhag la/ cho ga gzhan rnams snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyi rjes su/ bdag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs byas la/ rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams dang /

rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa dang / bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyod kyis sogs kyi mthar/ mtheb srin gyis se gol byas te/ badzra muḥ ye shes pa rnams dbyings su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas rol mo dang bcas pas/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā naṃ a dya nutpanna twa da/ ces dang / oṃ gi li gi li hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes brjod cing de kho na nyid dran pas rdo rje'i thog mar lha mtshan nas rang gi srin lag g.yon pas gang bsnyogs nas blangs la mgo la bzhag de nas dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa bshags pa'i rjes su tshangs thig gnyis kyi thad kyi mtha'i me ris nas dbus kyi mtshan ma'i bar phyogs bzhi ka nas rdo rjes 'then te gshegs su gsol ba phyag len yin/ rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa dang por gshegs/ de nas g.yas bskor gyi rim pas ci bde bar gshegs su gsol/ rdul tshon 'dod pa yod na lha'i mtshan ma nas blangs la byin/ gzhan rnams mtha' nas rim par bsdus te za ma tog la sogs par blugs la rdul tshon chu bor spyan drangs pa'i cho ga'am/ de tsam mi nus na bkur bsti chen pos rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung ngam/ khron pa la sogs par gshegs su gsol la/ thig rjes rnams dri zhim po'i chus mtha' nas rim pa bzhin phyis te rjes mi mngon par byas la/ de nas rang nyid rdo rje bdag med mar gsal ba'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ sogs dang / dge ba bsngo ba sogs sta gon bzhin byas la/ bkra shis ni/ mtshungs med bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /mthu stobs dbang phyug bla ma brgyud par bcas/ /mtshan nas brjod dam cung zad dran yang rung / /bkra shis 'phel zhing skye dgu bde legs shog /rang bzhin dri med blo gros glo bur gyi/ /dri mas sgrib par bsal bar mdzad pa yi/ /bdag med ma dpal lha mo bco lnga yi/ /bkra shis 'phel zhing skye dgu bde legs shog

/khams drug dag pa ye shes chen po'i sku/ /lam gyi yan lag sum cu rtsa bdun te/ /snang ba sangs rgyas zhing 'gyur gzhal med khang / /bkra shis phel zhing skye dgu bde legs shog /yan lag rnam dag khro bo chen po'i sku/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba bla bre gur/ /bdud dpung nges 'joms bsrung ba'i 'khor lo mchog /bkra shis 'phel zhing skye dgu bde legs shog /'dag bya dag byed nang ngam phyi na bzhugs/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu dang sprin dang shing / /mchod rten ro dang 'dre dang me dang chu/ /phyogs brgyad dag byed des ni bkra shis shog /bla ma dkyil 'khor gtso bo 'khor dang bcas/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed lam dang 'bras bu mchog /brjod dam de don cung zad dran yang rung / /bkra shis 'phel zhing skye dgu bde legs shog /ces dang gzhan yang chos skyong nor lha sogs kyi bkra shis rgyas pa brjod/ rol mo'i sgra bya zhing dkyil 'khor bris shul la me tog sil ma'i char dbab par bya'o/ /de rnams kyis bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ma tshang ba med pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyud sde'i nges gsang nye lam kun gyi bcud/ /bdag med mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor cho ga yi/ /rnam dbye gsal bar bstan pa'i legs bshad 'dis/ /gzhan phan phrin las kun tu khyab gyur cig /chos tshul mchog 'di sa skya pa las brgyud/ /brgyud pa gzhan dang thun mong bsre lhad bral/ /bral zhes mkhas mchog kun gyis bsngags par mdzad/ /mdzad pa 'di ni nges pa'i don dang ldan/ /'khrul zad gong ma'i gsung rab rgya mtsho las/ /bdag blo rab gsal ded dpon gyis blangs pa'i/ /lag len cho ga yid bzhin rin chen phreng / /'di ni skal bzang mdzes pa'i mgul rgyan yin/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams/ /tshe ring nad med bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing du padmo las/ /brdzus te skyes nas sa lam mthar phyin shog

/zhes rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i gsal byed 'phrin las kun khyab ces bya ba 'di ni/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs puṇya ind+ri dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sems dpa' chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros dang / gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son cing mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ma lus pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhabs la yan lag mchog gis reg cing gsung gi bdud rtsi ngom par 'thung ba'i skal ba bzang po can sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos snyoms chung don gnyer can rnams dpe 'bri bzung bde ba'i phyir rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos ne tse sbal ston la gnang ba'i dbang gi tho yig dang / de nyid spru lung pas cung zad gsal bar byas pa'i yi ge sogs dang / kun mkhyen chen po dang / ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil gyi yig cha khyad par can rnams dang / snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil dbang chog dang bcas pa zhib cing rgyas par bstan pa'i yig cha ngo mtshar can gyi gsung rtsom cung zad ma rdzogs pa'i kha skong 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can gyis mdzad pa sogs gsung rab tshad ldan de dag la zhib tu dpyad cing dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin bkod pa 'di ni/ rgya gar lugs la durma ti zhes pa blo ngan dang / rgya nag lugs la lcags mo bya yi lo me tog can gyi zla ba'i dmar cha rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi mkha' spyod dpal gyi pho brang du sbyar ba'o/ /'di'i dbang chog don du gnyer ba rnams kho bos byas pa'i slob ma dbang bskur gyi mtshams sbyor logs na yod pas der blta bar gyis shig
